keywordPolicy.chosen: Place-led keywords with reviewed clip IDs. Relevance still requires the place name in the clip metadata, and a reviewed clip list restricts a beat to clips a human has looked at.
keywordPolicy.consequence: Metadata cannot prove what a clip shows. Only clips on the reviewed list are used for scenes 3, 4 and the montage. Every reviewed clip was checked by contact sheet of its own frames (see review-assets/photogenic/footage/accepted).
keywordPolicy.rejectedAlternative: Place-only relevance without reviewed lists: the planner selected the Horseshoe Bend clips for Antelope Canyon, which were wrong.

expectedCoverage.method: Worker planner and preflight with free Pexels search metadata only. No narration, alignment, image generation or paid service. Scene durations are the saved estimatedSeconds; the aligned beat timings will change the shares and must be rechecked before any render.

footageDepth.Antelope Canyon: one verified interior clip (29510336); the other titled clips show Horseshoe Bend
footageDepth.Burano: 25 titled clips; 29918560 and 29918561 are two clips of the same street of houses

renderRequest.submitIntentId: one per owner action (a double click, a lost reply or a retry reuses it)
renderRequest.note: The worker refuses a second paid submission for the same script and render version, whatever its earlier state, and replays the same intent without starting a render. Requires the Apps Script change and a deployment (not yet authorised).

licensing.footage: Pexels License: free to use, including commercially, no attribution required. Do not resell the clips unedited or use them as the main product. Credit the uploader is optional; uploader names are recorded for each chosen clip.
licensing.music: Beyond These Walls (Scott Buckley), CC BY 4.0: attribution is required and is already included in the description the pipeline produces.
licensing.aiStills: Labelled AI-generated illustration (the label appears in the job record). Generated images are not footage and must not be presented as real footage.

openRisks: Antelope Canyon coverage is weak: only one verified interior clip exists in the candidates reviewed, and scenes 1 and 2 are labelled AI stills instead of footage.
Scene timing uses estimatedSeconds. Aligned beat timings change the shares and the coverage, and must be rechecked before any render.
